/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; cat jest.config.js; ls CHANGELOG* 2>/dev/null; git status --short --branch;"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "Add acceptance tests for non-Error rejections" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
